1900      async def _resolve_effective_wiki_publications(
 1901          session: AsyncSession,
 1902          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
 1903          spec: FrozenAgentSpec,
 1904      ) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
 1905          """Freeze the version's Wiki binding onto a new run.
 1906  
 1907          The published binding is already resolved (publish froze LATEST), so
 1908          this verifies the publication still exists under its frozen hash and
 1909          carries no revoked source. A revoked publication refuses the new run
 1910          outright instead of binding something the run cannot read.
 1911          """
 1912  
 1913          binding = spec.wiki_binding
 1914          if binding is None:
 1915              return []
 1916          wiki_context = context.model_copy(
 1917              update={"permissions": context.permissions | frozenset({"knowledge_run"})}
 1918          )
 1919          publication = await session.scalar(
 1920              select(WikiCompilation).where(
 1921                  WikiCompilation.workspace_id == UUID(context.workspace_id),
 1922                  WikiCompilation.knowledge_base_id == binding.knowledge_base_id,
 1923                  WikiCompilation.id == binding.wiki_publication_id,
 1924              )
 1925          )
 1926          if (
 1927              publication is None
 1928              or publication.status != "PUBLISHED"
 1929              or publication.content_hash != binding.publication_hash
 1930          ):
 1931              raise AgentHubError(
 1932                  "AGENT_VERSION_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
 1933                  "The published Wiki binding is invalid.",
 1934                  422,
 1935              )
 1936          await _assert_wiki_publication_not_revoked(session, wiki_context, publication)
 1937          return [
 1938              {
 1939                  "knowledge_base_id": str(binding.knowledge_base_id),
 1940                  "binding_mode": binding.binding_mode,
 1941                  "wiki_publication_id": str(binding.wiki_publication_id),
 1942                  "publication_hash": binding.publication_hash,
 1943              }
 1944          ]

124  def _project(result: Mapping[str, Any], compilation: WikiCompilation) -> dict[str, Any]:
  125      """Reshape the wiki query result into the unified evidence envelope.
  126  
  127      Publication identity travels inside every WIKI_DERIVED record; the
  128      observation layer's registry projection keeps it out of the model-visible
  129      payload.
  130      """
  131  
  132      projected: dict[tuple[str, ...], tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, str]]] = {}
  133      ordered: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
  134      for item in result.get("evidence") or []:
  135          try:
  136              record = _record(item)
  137          except (KeyError, TypeError):
  138              raise ToolHandlerError(
  139                  "WIKI_ENVELOPE_INVALID", "The Wiki evidence record is malformed."
  140              ) from None
  141          reason = envelope_violation(record)
  142          if reason is not None:
  143              raise ToolHandlerError(
  144                  "WIKI_ENVELOPE_INVALID", "The Wiki evidence record is missing its envelope."
  145              ) from None
  146          identity = (
  147              str(record["origin"]),
  148              str(record["document_revision_id"]),
  149              str(record["chunk_id"]),
  150              str(record.get("quote", "")),
  151              str(record.get("wiki_page_id") or record.get("page_id") or ""),
  152          )
  153          if identity in projected:
  154              continue
  155          projected[identity] = (
  156              record,
  157              {
  158                  "snapshot_id": str(compilation.source_snapshot_id),
  159                  "knowledge_base_id": str(compilation.knowledge_base_id),
  160                  "document_revision_id": str(record["document_revision_id"]),
  161                  "chunk_id": str(record["chunk_id"]),
  162              },
  163          )
  164          ordered.append(identity)
  165  
  166      route = result.get("route")
  167      selected: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
  168      if route == "HYBRID":
  169          # The extractor may return all Wiki claims before any RAW hit. Reserve
  170          # one count slot per origin before filling the remaining rank order;
  171          # otherwise ten useful claims can silently hide the raw passage that
  172          # made this a HYBRID answer.
  173          for origin in (EVIDENCE_ORIGIN_WIKI_DERIVED, EVIDENCE_ORIGIN_RAW):
  174              match = next((key for key in ordered if key[0] == origin), None)
  175              if match is not None:
  176                  selected.append(match)
  177      for key in ordered:
  178          if len(selected) >= _MAX_RESULTS:
  179              break
  180          if key not in selected:
  181              selected.append(key)
  182  
  183      records = [projected[key][0] for key in selected[:_MAX_RESULTS]]
  184      references = [projected[key][1] for key in selected[:_MAX_RESULTS]]
  185      delivered_origins = sorted({record["origin"] for record in records})
  186      degraded = False
  187      degraded_reason = None
  188      if route == "HYBRID":
  189          expected_origins = {EVIDENCE_ORIGIN_WIKI_DERIVED, EVIDENCE_ORIGIN_RAW}
  190          if set(delivered_origins) != expected_origins:
  191              degraded = True
  192              degraded_reason = "HYBRID_PARTIAL_DELIVERY"
  193      if len(records) < len(ordered):
  194          degraded = True
  195          degraded_reason = degraded_reason or "EVIDENCE_COUNT_LIMIT"
  196      return {
  197          "binding": {
  198              "knowledge_base_id": str(compilation.knowledge_base_id),
  199              "wiki_publication_id": str(compilation.id),
  200              "publication_hash": str(compilation.content_hash),
  201              "source_snapshot_id": str(compilation.source_snapshot_id),
  202          },
  203          "route": route,
  204          "insufficient_evidence": bool(result.get("insufficient_evidence")),
  205          "supplemental_required": bool(result.get("supplemental_required")),
  206          "conflict_count": len(result.get("conflicts") or []),
  207          "degraded": degraded,
  208          "degraded_reason": degraded_reason,
  209          "delivered_origins": delivered_origins,
  210          "results": records,
  211          "evidence_refs": references,
  212      }

342  def plan_history(
  343      groups: Sequence[HistorySourceGroup],
  344      *,
  345      scope: HistoryScope,
  346      frozen_watermark: int,
  347      counter: HistoryTokenCounter,
  348      b_work_tokens: int,
  349      unaccounted_growth_tokens: int = 0,
  350      work_limit: HistoryWorkLimit | None = None,
  351      summary_verifier: Callable[[HistorySourceGroup, HistoryScope], bool] | None = None,
  352      expected_counter_id: str | None = None,
  353      expected_counter_version: int | None = None,
  354      thresholds: HistoryThresholds | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
  355  ) -> HistoryPlan:
  356      """Return a deterministic all-or-nothing source-group plan.
  357  
  358      The caller must freeze pagination before constructing ``groups``.  Groups
  359      beyond ``frozen_watermark``, across another scope, split across multiple
  360      ``exchange_id`` values, or measured by another counter version are rejected
  361      as contract errors.  A group that does not fit the shared budget is dropped
  362      whole; no source can be partially selected or projected here.
  363      """
  364  
  365      if not isinstance(scope, HistoryScope):
  366          raise TypeError("scope must be HistoryScope")
  367      _require_non_negative_int(frozen_watermark, "frozen_watermark")
  368      _require_positive_int(b_work_tokens, "b_work_tokens")
  369      _require_non_negative_int(unaccounted_growth_tokens, "unaccounted_growth_tokens")
  370      limit = work_limit or HistoryWorkLimit(max_groups=256)
  371      _validate_counter(counter)
  372      if expected_counter_id is not None and counter.counter_id != expected_counter_id:
  373          raise HistoryPlanContractError("history counter differs from the frozen policy")
  374      if expected_counter_version is not None and counter.counter_version != expected_counter_version:
  375          raise HistoryPlanContractError("history counter version differs from the frozen policy")
  376      ordered = _validate_and_order_groups(
  377          groups,
  378          scope=scope,
  379          frozen_watermark=frozen_watermark,
  380          counter_version=counter.counter_version,
  381      )
  382      measured_inputs = ordered[: limit.max_groups]
  383      measured = tuple(_measure_group(group, counter) for group in measured_inputs)
  384      measurement_complete = len(ordered) <= limit.max_groups
  385      unmeasured_count = max(len(ordered) - len(measured), 0)
  386  
  387      decisions: dict[str, SourceGroupDecision] = {}
  388      token_counts = {item.group.group_id: item.tokens for item in measured}
  389      source_groups = tuple(
  390          item for item in measured if item.category is not HistoryCategory.VERIFIED_SUMMARY
  391      )
  392      summary_groups = tuple(
  393          item for item in measured if item.category is HistoryCategory.VERIFIED_SUMMARY
  394      )
  395      pre_trim_tokens = sum(item.tokens for item in source_groups)
  396      planned_tokens = pre_trim_tokens + unaccounted_growth_tokens
  397      thresholds = _thresholds(b_work_tokens, thresholds)
  398      pre_trim_pressure = _pressure(planned_tokens, thresholds)
  399  
  400      mandatory = tuple(item for item in source_groups if item.category is HistoryCategory.MANDATORY)
  401      mandatory_total = sum(item.tokens for item in mandatory)
  402      if mandatory_total > b_work_tokens:
  403          raise AgentHubError(
  404              MANDATORY_OVERFLOW_CODE,
  405              MANDATORY_OVERFLOW_MESSAGE,
  406              422,
  407          )
  408  
  409      selected_ids: set[str] = set()
  410      remaining = b_work_tokens
  411      reason_codes: list[PlanReason] = []
  412      insufficiencies: list[Insufficiency] = []
  413  
  414      for item in mandatory:
  415          selected_ids.add(item.group.group_id)
  416          remaining -= item.tokens
  417          decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  418              item,
  419              retained=True,
  420              reason=DecisionReason.RETAINED_MANDATORY,
  421          )
  422  
  423      # G is absent from every source group, but it still competes for the same
  424      # working window.  Reserve it before source selection so a post-trim
  425      # pressure result cannot look healthy by ignoring expected growth.
  426      if unaccounted_growth_tokens > remaining:
  427          raise AgentHubError(
  428              "AGENT_HISTORY_GROWTH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
  429              "Anticipated context growth exceeds the remaining input budget.",
  430              422,
  431          )
  432      remaining -= unaccounted_growth_tokens
  433  
  434      keep_exact = tuple(
  435          item for item in source_groups if item.category is HistoryCategory.KEEP_EXACT
  436      )
  437      for item in _newest_first(keep_exact):
  438          if item.tokens <= remaining:
  439              selected_ids.add(item.group.group_id)
  440              remaining -= item.tokens
  441              decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  442                  item,
  443                  retained=True,
  444                  reason=DecisionReason.RETAINED_KEEP_EXACT,
  445              )
  446          else:
  447              decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  448                  item,
  449                  retained=False,
  450                  reason=DecisionReason.DROPPED_SHARED_BUDGET,
  451              )
  452  
  453      recent = tuple(item for item in source_groups if item.category is HistoryCategory.RECENT)
  454      recent_suffix_open = True
  455      for item in _newest_first(recent):
  456          if recent_suffix_open and item.tokens <= remaining:
  457              selected_ids.add(item.group.group_id)
  458              remaining -= item.tokens
  459              decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  460                  item,
  461                  retained=True,
  462                  reason=DecisionReason.RETAINED_RECENT,
  463              )
  464          else:
  465              recent_suffix_open = False
  466              decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  467                  item,
  468                  retained=False,
  469                  reason=DecisionReason.DROPPED_RECENT_SUFFIX_GAP,
  470              )
  471  
  472      eligible = tuple(
  473          item
  474          for item in source_groups
  475          if item.category is HistoryCategory.OPTIONAL
  476          and item.group.summary_eligibility is SummaryEligibility.ELIGIBLE
  477      )
  478      coverage_validation = _coverage_validation(
  479          summary_groups,
  480          source_groups=source_groups,
  481          eligible=eligible,
  482      )
  483      for item in summary_groups:
  484          if summary_verifier is None or summary_verifier(item.group, scope) is not True:
  485              coverage_validation[item.group.group_id] = "summary publication is not verified"
  486      covered_ids: set[str] = set()
  487  
  488      if pre_trim_pressure is not PlanPressure.NONE and eligible:
  489          summaries = tuple(
  490              sorted(
  491                  summary_groups,
  492                  key=lambda item: (
  493                      -(
  494                          sum(
  495                              token_counts.get(coverage.source_group_id, 0)
  496                              for coverage in item.group.coverage
  497                          )
  498                          - item.tokens
  499                      ),
  500                      -item.group.sequence,
  501                      item.group.group_id,
  502                  ),
  503              )
  504          )
  505          for item in summaries:
  506              invalid_reason = coverage_validation.get(item.group.group_id)
  507              covered = {coverage.source_group_id for coverage in item.group.coverage}
  508              if invalid_reason is not None:
  509                  decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  510                      item,
  511                      retained=False,
  512                      reason=DecisionReason.DROPPED_SUMMARY_COVERAGE_INVALID,
  513                  )
  514                  continue
  515              if covered & covered_ids:
  516                  decisions[item.group.group_id] = _source_decision(
  517                      item,
  518                      retained=False,
  519                      reason=DecisionReason.DROPPED_SUMMARY_NOT_NEEDED,
  520                  )
  521                  continue

1  """The two seams the work layer plugs into the runtime through.
    2  
    3  Threads and artifacts sit *above* the runtime: they read agent runs, so they
    4  depend on this package and this package must not depend on them. The runtime
    5  therefore declares what it needs as protocols here, and composition wires the
    6  real implementations in. Without a provider the runtime behaves exactly as it
